opakalim_deal.status: closing delayed; upfront unpaid as of public 2026-09-11 update

opakalim_partial_hold.reason: FDA requested additional verification of a metabolite toxicity signal seen in rodent nonclinical work
opakalim_partial_hold.rise3: enrollment already completed; topline still targeted for 2H 2026
opakalim_partial_hold.company_human_exposure_statement: >1,200 subjects and no directly related human adverse event identified

xcopri_ip.generic_litigation: one settlement with confidential future launch rights; two other disputes remain

governance.audit_key_matter: product revenue occurrence and U.S. rebates/discounts/returns estimation

inferences: XCOPRI is a high-quality commercial cash engine with strong U.S. direct-sales operating leverage.
The key underwriting transition is from a single-product cash cow to a multi-product CNS franchise before the 2032 compound-patent cliff.
Opakalim is strategically coherent because it can reuse the U.S. neurology infrastructure, but deal size plus the partial hold make incremental ROIC the central capital-allocation question.
The FDA hold is not evidence of human toxicity, but the appraiser 71.9% modeled success probability should not be treated as clinical fact.
